about_the_game:
FIGHT THE LOOP. ESCAPE THE INEVITABLE.

HAXRAIL is a fast-paced roguelite shooter set in a star system consumed by a temporal catastrophe. You came for a rescue. Now, you're trapped in an endless war, fighting to survive as reality itself fractures around you.

HIGH-SPEED COMBAT IN A DYING SYSTEM

Master momentum-based movement and precision shooting in intense dogfights. Boost, drift, and evade to outmaneuver relentless enemies. Upgrade your ship, chain abilities, and push deeper into the unknown.

HAX SHARDS: POWER OR SURVIVAL

Hax Shards fuel everything. Spend them mid-battle to unleash devastating abilities, or save them for upgrades at hidden shops and black markets. Every choice matters: power now or progress later?

CHANGE UNIVERSE FATE AT EACH RUN

No run is the same. Choose randomized perks, adapt to evolving enemy tactics, and uncover hidden paths and secrets that persist across loops.

FACTIONS, MYSTERIES, AND CONSEQUENCES

The Dominion Authority wants control. The Revenants worship the anomaly. The Scavengers profit from the chaos. Choose your alliances... and betray them. Your actions shape the next cycle.

DESCEND INTO THE UNKNOWN

The Haxrail is expanding. Time is unraveling. Your past will not save you. Your future is uncertain. Fight, adapt, and discover the truth before the loop consumes you.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or later, SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU (GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570 or better)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (8th Gen)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated M1 GPU / Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
